Bill.BriefDescription: Continuing the office of regulatory assistance without a termination date.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the office of regulatory assistance; creating anew section; and repealing RCW 43.131.401 and 43.131.402.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The legislature finds that it has bothrefined and added to the role of the office of regulatory assistanceand that the office of regulatory assistance: (a) Complies with legislative intent where the statutes have beenin place long enough to measure such compliance; (b) Has improved in its documentation demonstrating that it meetsestablished goals and targets; and (c) Does not substantially duplicate services offered by otheragencies or the private sector. (2) The legislature also finds that continuing the office ofregulatory assistance would contribute to its ongoing efforts to makepermitting processes easier to navigate. (3) Therefore, pursuant to the October 2010 recommendation of thejoint legislative audit and review committee, the legislature intendsto repeal the sunset of the office of regulatory assistance andcontinue the office without a termination date.

The following acts or parts of acts are eachrepealed: RCW 43.131.401 (Office of regulatory assistanceTermination)and 2007 c 231 s 6, 2007 c 94 s 15, 2003 c 71 s 5, & 2002 c 153 s 13;and RCW 43.131.402 (Office of regulatory assistanceRepeal) and2010 c 162 s 7.
